Subject: Compact speaker blocks + staggered handovers — dry run options

Hi Dana (and team),

Thanks again for agreeing to join the November 18 webinar. We ran into a scheduling conflict on our side — two SMEs have overlapping demos — and to keep the session crisp we're proposing a compact-block format with staggered handovers (three short demo segments back-to-back with a soft handoff).

Quick asks:
- Can you do a tech check + greenroom at 08:30 PT on Nov 9?
- For the live session, would you be comfortable doing a 6–7 minute demo focused on integration highlights (we'll cue you at T+12)?
- Please review the attached speaker-preflight-sheet.xlsx — it includes preferred capture settings and a one-line bio we can use.

I've attached a minimal runbook (runbook_v2.pdf) and a compact schedule CSV. Lauren, can you lead the greenroom? Karthik, tagging you for demo-order decision if we need to swap demo 2/3. Soojin, can you confirm captioning availability for the live stream?

Thanks — aiming to lock this today so we can update slides and the registration page.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Events Program Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: speaker-preflight-sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet), runbook_v2.pdf (pdf), compact-blocks-schedule-v1.csv (csv)

Subject: Re: Compact speaker blocks + staggered handovers — dry run options

Hi Vanessa — thanks for the heads up and for the attachments. Nov 9 at 08:30 PT works for a quick tech check; I'll plan to join from a company laptop (we use native audio + dual-monitor share).

The 6–7 minute demo is perfect — we'll tighten the script to focus on the integration flow and one measurable outcome. I updated the preflight sheet with my AV notes (file: speaker-preflight-sheet.xlsx).

Two small asks:
1) Could we confirm whether we'll use gallery or speaker view for live demo switching? Gallery makes it easier to see the handoff.
2) If demo 2 needs to swap with demo 3, advise whether Karthik prefers us to keep the same asset order or present a trimmed flow.

Looking forward to the greenroom.

—Dana

Subject: Re: Compact speaker blocks + staggered handovers — dry run options

Vanessa — happy to run greenroom. I can be on at 08:15 PT to set up the cue sheet and confirm the captions flow. For the live session, my recommendation: use speaker view for the main presenter and a split-screen when handoffs happen (so we can show the demo and keep the host visible). That reduces context switching for attendees.

If we need to swap demo 2/3 I'd prefer the shorter, high-impact demo stay in the earlier slot to keep momentum. I'll prep the cue cards and brief Dana in the greenroom.

I'll drop a slimmed-down cue sheet into the Drive link and make sure AV knows to enable live captions.

—Lauren

Thanks team — I've sketched an updated flow and uploaded it here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-Event-Runbook (file: compact-blocks-schedule-v1.csv). TL;DR: swap demo 2 and 3 so the attendee-impact demo lands second (keeps Q&A focused).

Notes:
- Handovers will be 15–20s: host reads the sentence 'I’m handing this over to Dana for the integration demo' while the next presenter shares.
- Use a single shared slide deck for transitions to avoid display re-attach latency. Give presenters 60s to confirm screen share.
- Captioning confirmed by Soojin.

I'll be on the greenroom call Nov 9 at 08:15 PT as backup. 

—Karthik

- We'll use speaker view for primary demos and a split-screen cue for the 15–20s handoffs.
- Demo order swapped as discussed — attendee-impact demo is demo 2.
- Captions: enabled by Soojin.

I've attached an updated runbook (runbook_v2.pdf) with cue times and a trimmed 1-page host script at the top. If there are no objections by EOD Nov 9 I'll publish the final speaker note and update the registration reminder.
